corrections.why: The register, firetower.org and Wikipedia all say the lookout was dismantled at Henninger Flats in 2025. The record still says standing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The firetower.org record gives 'Removed' as 1978, while the register says the lookout went out of service in 1971 and was moved around 1978. The 1971 date is when service ended; 1978 is when it moved.

notes_for_editor: All three sources give 2025 for the dismantling, but none gives a month or an LA County Fire statement; one WebSearch found no confirmation that it has been re-erected at the Fairplex. Wikipedia gives the tower as 22 by 22 feet, while the register says a 22-foot tower; the register's wording was used and the disagreement is unresolved. The record's height is left null because no source gives a cab-floor height. The Wikipedia Henninger Flats article may mention the 2025 Eaton Fire; it was not read and is not used.
